data.description: Resolves local project registrations and uses the same shared storage factory as MCP. Reads the portable .adashi/storage.json descriptor; missing selects legacy SQLite, malformed/future/unavailable configurations fail before store creation. Local registration aliases never replace canonical stored identity. Initialization/seeding/schema compatibility belongs to the selected adapter. Task 13 retains an explicit SQLite connection bridge for unmigrated callers; task 14 removes it.
data.name: Project Runtime
